title: Dunning & reminders
structure: Topbar: h1 "Dunning & reminders", then div.top-right holding one div.btn-primary-sm [plus svg + span "New template"]. No top-search, no back chevron. The .content block holds a single div.main-grid with inline style display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;gap:18px;. LEFT COLUMN (1.3fr): div.panel-head with inline margin-bottom:12px containing h3 (inline Poppins 14.5px, navy-900, weight 600) "Recent sends"; then table.data-table with a thead row of six th — Unit, Step, Channel, Sent, Balance, Status — and five tbody tr, each cell plain text except the last which holds div.dun-status with a modifier: Lot 47 | Reminder 1 | Push + Email | Today, 9:00 AM | $12,400 | dun-status.sent "Delivered"; Lot 31 | Reminder 4 | Push + Email + SMS | Today, 9:00 AM | $31,600 | dun-status.sent "Delivered"; Lot 9 | Reminder 2 | Push + Email | Yesterday | $18,600 | dun-status.sent "Delivered"; Lot 21 | Reminder 5 | Push + Email + SMS | Today, 9:00 AM | $44,900 | dun-status.failed "SMS failed"; Lot 63 | Advance notice | Push + Email | Sep 20, 9:00 AM | $6,200 | dun-status.sent "Delivered". RIGHT COLUMN (1fr): div.panel-head with inline margin-bottom:12px containing h3 "Message templates"; then div.tmpl-tabs with three div.tmpl-tab in order "Day 20", "Reminder 1" (carries .active, navy-600 ground, white text), "Reminder 4+"; then div.tmpl-editor (white card, navy-100 border, radius 14, padding 16) containing div.tmpl-body (navy-100 ground, radius 11) whose text is "Hi {resident_first_name}, your maintenance fee of {amount_due} for {unit_label} is now overdue. Please settle it at your earliest convenience to avoid further reminders." with each merge token wrapped in <b> and rendered amber-700; then div.merge-row with five div.merge-chip: {resident_first_name}, {unit_label}, {amount_due}, {due_date}, {days_overdue}; then a div.stack-btn.primary with inline style width:100%;justify-content:center; and span "Save template" (text only, no svg).
table_headers: Unit | Step | Channel | Sent | Balance | Status
domain_needs: route: /finance/dunning; page title "Dunning & reminders" (distinct from the unit-level "Dunning log" tab on screen 6 which links here)
dunning_send.unit_label — "Lot 47", "Lot 31", "Lot 9", "Lot 21", "Lot 63" (rendered without the phase prefix used elsewhere)

dunning_send.step — enumeration and ordering: "Advance notice", "Reminder 1", "Reminder 2", "Reminder 4", "Reminder 5" (implies a numbered escalation ladder with at least 5 reminder steps plus a pre-due advance notice)
dunning_send.channels — a multi-value set rendered with " + " separators: "Push + Email" for early steps, "Push + Email + SMS" for steps 4 and 5, so channel escalation is a property of the step
dunning_send.sent_at — rendered relatively ("Today, 9:00 AM", "Yesterday") or absolutely ("Sep 20, 9:00 AM"); the repeated 9:00 AM implies a scheduled daily dunning batch at 09:00
dunning_send.balance_at_send — the unit AR balance snapshotted at send time: $12,400 / $31,600 / $18,600 / $44,900 / $6,200

dunning_send.status — enumeration with at least Delivered (green, .sent) and a per-channel failure state "SMS failed" (red, .failed); failure is channel-specific, so delivery status must be tracked per channel, not just per send
dunning_send.sort_order — the list is not strictly time-ordered as drawn (Sep 20 row sits last after Today/Yesterday rows), so an explicit order or a stored position is needed to reproduce it
cross-screen tie: Lot 47 $12,400, Lot 31 $31,600, Lot 9 $18,600, Lot 21 $44,900 match the screen-5 arrears balances exactly; Lot 63 $6,200 is a unit not shown on screen 5
message_template.key/tab_label — "Day 20", "Reminder 1", "Reminder 4+" (tab set is a grouping of steps, with 4+ covering the final escalations)
message_template.body — the editable text with inline merge tokens; must store the raw token text
merge_token catalogue: {resident_first_name}, {unit_label}, {amount_due}, {due_date}, {days_overdue} — five available tokens, only three used in the shown body
template action: Save template (persist body) and New template (create) from the topbar
charge type referenced in the copy: "maintenance fee" — ties the reminder to the recurring maintenance charge seen on screen 6
accounting_notes: AR COLLECTIONS / DUNNING LOG. The "Balance" column is the unit's outstanding AR debit balance snapshotted at the moment each reminder was sent, and it ties directly to the screen-5 arrears table and the screen-6 unit ledger: Lot 47 $12,400 (matches Andrea Fletcher's ledger closing balance and her arrears row), Lot 31 $31,600 (Omar Brown), Lot 9 $18,600 (Ricardo Hall), Lot 21 $44,900 (Tanya Simms); Lot 63 $6,200 is an additional unit at exactly one month's maintenance fee. The escalation ladder maps to the ageing buckets on screen 5: Lot 47 is 30 days and on Reminder 1; Lot 9 is 60 days and on Reminder 2; Lots 31 and 21 are 90+ days and on Reminders 4 and 5 with SMS added — so dunning_step is driven by the ageing bucket / days past due. "Advance notice" on Lot 63 is a pre-due-date reminder against a current (non-overdue) balance. The template body's {amount_due} resolves to the same unit balance figure. Dunning generates NO journal entries — nothing here debits or credits the ledger; it is a communications log over the AR sub-ledger. Note the linkage to screen 7: an active payment plan suppresses these automated sends, so any rebuild must exclude on-plan units from the 09:00 batch.
